aiia.concept.body: Download a .md file that summarizes everything the app can do. Give it to any AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Le Chat, Copilot, etc.) — it will be able to answer all your questions about MyKTAMap with precise, up-to-date context.
aiia.how.step1: Pick your topic below, then 📋 Copy the context (or 📥 Download)
aiia.how.step2: Open the AI of your choice (web, mobile app, etc.)
aiia.how.step3: Copy-paste the file into the first message of the conversation
aiia.how.step4: Ask your questions: "How do I add a point?", "My plan is crashing, what do I do?", etc.
aiia.note.body: Using an AI may be paid or limited depending on the service (free ChatGPT with quotas, Claude Pro, etc.). MyKTAMap stays free — the downloaded context is just to help an external AI answer you better.
aiia.privacy.body: The file contains only the app's documentation — no personal data (none of your plans, points, sessions, photos). If you tick "technical state", it additionally includes anonymous technical info (version, device, plan modes, latest errors) — never your plan names or map data.
aiia.prompt.intro: Paste this text together with the .md file in the AI's first message. It sets the rules and limits hallucinations.
aiia.prompt.text:
Here is the official context of the MyKTAMap application (attached .md file or text pasted below).

You will help me use it by following these STRICT rules:

⛔ Answer ONLY from the content of the provided context.
⛔ If a feature is not described in it, say so clearly — NEVER make things up.
⛔ Do not extrapolate from other apps (Google Maps, QGIS, etc.).
⛔ You have access neither to the source code, nor the website, nor my application.
✅ Cite the section of the context where you find the info (e.g. "According to the Route recipe…").
✅ Use the exact icons and labels mentioned in the doc, with concrete steps.
✅ Always answer in MY language.
✅ If a "🔧 Installation state" block is present at the end of the context, use it for troubleshooting.

If you have understood, simply reply "OK, ready" and wait for my first question.

compass.modal.hint: The N on the rose always points to true North. If you walk holding the phone flat in your hand (top of phone = walking direction):
compass.modal.title: 🧭 Compass — Magnetic North

config.display.intersections.hint: Filled colored circle where 2 paths cross (green × purple → yellow, etc.). Uncheck to declutter very dense maps, or if the computation slows down rendering. Immediate effect, saved per map (another map keeps its own setting).
config.display.intersections.label: ⚪ Show circles at intersections (this map)
config.display.north.hint: CW angle between the TOP of the map and true North. 0° = North up (default). If the North arrow points to the right of the map → 90°. Applied to the tracker (icon rotation + heading); the compass keeps showing true magnetic North independently.
config.display.north.label: 🧭 North calibration (this map)
config.display.scaledMarkers.hint: On by default: point icons shrink when you zoom out (constant size relative to the map). Uncheck = standard Leaflet behavior (fixed screen-size icons, they become huge when zoomed out). Reload required after changing.
config.display.scaledMarkers.label: 📐 Scale icon size with zoom
config.display.vibration.hint: Small vibration for confirmations (waypoint reached, action validated, alert). Uncheck = total silence (useful underground with other people, or for meditation). iOS Safari does not support the Web Vibration API — on iPhone, this toggle stays hidden. Global preference, kept across sessions.
config.display.vibration.label: 📳 Haptic vibration
config.display.voice.hint: Control the app by voice: zoom, center, search, add point, tracker on/off, emergency/rescue mode, light/dark theme… Push-to-talk via a floating 🎤 button bottom-right. Say “help” out loud to list the available commands. Microphone permission requested on first use. Reload required after changing (to inject/remove the button).
config.display.voice.label: 🎤 Voice commands (BETA)
config.display.voice.toastOn: 🎤 Voice commands enabled. 🎤 button shown at bottom right.
config.display.wakelock.hint: Prevents the screen from sleeping while the app is open. Ideal underground so you don't have to unlock your phone every 30s. Persistent across sessions. The wake lock is auto-released when you switch tab/app, and re-enabled on return if the box is checked.
config.display.wakelock.label: 🔆 Keep screen on (Wake Lock)
config.display.wakelock.toastOn: 🔆 Screen kept on while the app is open

config.georef.errInvalidGps: Invalid GPS coordinates — fix the fields in red.
config.georef.intro: Calibrate the map by entering 2 reference points (map x/y coordinates + WGS84 GPS lat/lng). MyKTAMap computes the rotation+scale+translation transform to project all annotations onto the globe. The calibration is saved locally per map and automatically pre-filled when you open 📡 External export (KMZ / GPX) or import a GPX.
config.georef.okSaved: ✅ Calibration saved. Auto-filled in 📡 External export.
config.georef.pointCHint: Corrects a globally distorted map (stretched assembly, different X/Y scales). Pick a point FAR from the A-B line. Leave empty if your map already projects well.
config.georef.errCIncomplete: Point C is incomplete: fill its 4 fields (X, Y, GPS) or leave them all empty.
config.georef.errCColineaire: Point C is too aligned with A and B: pick a point far from the A-B line (otherwise it adds nothing).
config.incognito.confirmQuit:
Leave incognito mode?

All points/notes/tracker data accumulated in this window will be lost.
config.incognito.quit.desc:
Closes this incognito window. All accumulated data (points, tracker, notes) will be lost. Your main session stays intact in its own tab.
If the browser blocks the close, the tab automatically reloads in normal mode.
config.incognito.start.desc:
Opens a new window where no data is saved (no photos, no tracker, no preferences). Ideal for exploring a map in a public demo, lending your session to someone, or testing without polluting your local history. A visible purple border + a title badge remind you of the context.
On reload: everything is gone.

config.jonction.errSameLevel: Start and end levels must be different.
config.jonction.hint: After OK, click on the map to place the junction's points (as many as you want). The path will be dashed magenta and stay visible regardless of the active level.
config.jonction.intro: This junction (stairs, steep slope, internal shaft) links two levels.
config.lang.hint: Changes the language of the whole app (screens, menus, settings). The documentation and tutorial keep their own independent language choice.
config.mlvl.intro:
Enables level (floor) management for multi-floor quarries. Adds a level selector to the 🛣️ Paths group plus a 🪜 Inter-level junction sub-action. Existing roads with no explicit level are automatically treated as level 0.
Disabled by default — only for maps that need it (Glacière, Capucins, etc.).
config.mlvl.toggle.hint: Saved per map. Reload required for the UI changes to appear in the sidebar.
config.mlvl.toggle.label: 🏗️ Enable multi-level mode for this map
config.niveaux.active.hint: All new elements (paths, points, zones, repositioned tracker) will be tagged with this level.
config.niveaux.controlTitle: Active level — click to change / filter
config.niveaux.visible.hint: Check the levels you want to show on the map. Junctions are visible if at least one of their endpoints touches a checked level.
config.niveaux.warn: ⚠️ Changing the active level cancels any path in progress and resets the visible filter to [active].
config.north.statusCalibrated: ✅ North calibrated at {deg}° from the top of the map (clockwise).
config.north.statusDefault: ℹ️ North = top of the map (default configuration).
config.perfultra.animOff.hint: Instant pan/zoom instead of animated. Reload required after changing.
config.perfultra.animOff.label: ⚡ Disable zoom/pan animations
config.perfultra.decim.hint: Simplifies polylines via Ramer-Douglas-Peucker. Paths look less smooth when zoomed out but render much faster.
config.perfultra.decim.label: 🪜 Decimate paths when zooming out
config.perfultra.intro: For large maps / weak devices. Enable 🚀 ULTRA to apply all optimizations at once, or tweak each lever individually. Changes apply on the fly — except options marked with an orange border, which require reloading the map to take effect.
config.perfultra.mobileZoomLimit.hint: Checked by default. On smartphones, caps the maximum zoom-out to avoid an OOM crash when Leaflet tries to render the whole image at minZoom. Unchecking allows the same max zoom-out as on PC (useful for an overview) but risks crashing on large maps. Reload required after changing.
config.perfultra.mobileZoomLimit.label: 🛡️ Limit zoom-out on mobile (memory crash guard)
config.perfultra.noIntersect.hint: Threshold lowered to 50 routes (vs 200 normally). No circles at crossroads beyond that.
config.perfultra.noIntersect.label: 🎯 Disable intersection circles (large maps)
config.perfultra.noTooltips.hint: No more popup when clicking markers on data layers. Session points stay interactive. Use 🔍 to interact.
config.perfultra.noTooltips.label: 🚫 Disable popups on data layers
config.perfultra.slowSave.hint: Auto-save every 30s instead of 1.5s. Risk of losing ~30s of changes on a crash.
config.perfultra.slowSave.label: 🐢 Slow auto-save (30s)
config.perfultra.ultra.hint: Preset that enables the 7 toggles below. Unchecking disables everything.
config.perfultra.ultra.label: 🚀 ULTRA mode (enables everything)
config.perfultra.viewportCull.hint: Skips routes AND POI markers outside the viewport. Slight pop-in when panning but a huge gain on dense maps (100+ POI).
config.perfultra.viewportCull.label: 👁️ Render only visible elements
config.presentation.desc: Hides the header + sidebars + footer to free up the whole surface for the map. Exit: <kbd>F</kbd> or <kbd>Esc</kbd> (PC), or the floating ✕ button top-right (mobile).
config.smartnav.hint: Off by default. When the map has a network of paths, the estimated position is snapped to the nearest gallery to offset sensor drift (compass / steps). Off-network, it automatically returns to the current behavior. Without paths on the map, the option has no effect.
config.smartnav.label: 🧭 Snap position to paths
config.smartnav.headingHint: Penalty for heading misalignment at junctions (default 0.7). Lower it to pass junctions more easily even when misaligned; 0 = heading no longer used.
config.smartnav.radiusHint: Max distance from the trace before decoupling (default 6). Increase if you decouple too easily.
config.smartnav.warn: ⚠️ Expert settings. A wrong value can degrade or completely break tracking. If something goes wrong: restore the defaults (6 and 0.7) or reset the settings.

export.full.anonymizeHint:
Replaces names with codes (💎 POI #1, 🛣️ Path #1, ⬛ Zone #1…), clears descriptions/notes, removes GPS history and profile. Coordinates, tags and map structure preserved — usable by anyone who knows the area.
📸 Photos can be included: each photo is re-encoded without metadata (EXIF/GPS stripped). The free note and History PDF remain excluded.
export.full.intro: Export the full session so you can re-import it and resume your work.
export.full.introDetail: Includes points, paths, zones, structures, measurement and the GPS tracker timeline if present (useful for the heatmap).
export.full.photosHint: If checked AND at least 1 photo: the export will be a .zip containing session.json + photos/. If unchecked OR 0 photo: a standard .json export.
export.gpx.formatLine: 📐 Format: standard GPX 1.1 XML. M-LVL levels are preserved via a <cmt>MyKTAMap level=N</cmt> comment.
export.gpx.roundtripLine: 🔄 Roundtrip: re-importable into MyKTAMap with levels + map coords restored + the custom map legend (since v1.18.1, via standard <extensions> ignored by third-party apps).
export.kmz.niveauxHint: Default: all available levels (1 KML Folder per level).

home.netdoc.docOutro: (Opens in a new tab — it is a static file served by the same Nginx as the app.)
home.netdoc.lead: MyKTAMap is a 100% client-side PWA. Everything you create (annotations, sessions, saved maps, KMZ calibrations, preferences) stays in your browser. The Nginx server only serves static files. No application backend, no server database, no analytics, no tracking cookie.
home.netdoc.quote: « If you find anything that contradicts this page, contact me (Instagram @karma_kta or contact@myktamap.fr) — I will fix it immediately. »
home.netdoc.scope1: This security and no-telemetry guarantee applies ONLY to the official domain myktamap.fr (and to the development environment dev.myktamap.fr, run by the same author).
home.netdoc.scope2: MyKTAMap's source code is public (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and can be copied, forked or mirrored by anyone. Any third-party install — whatever name or domain it uses, even one claiming to be « MyKTAMap » — may contain modifications we are not responsible for: added tracking, data exfiltration, injected malicious code. We have no way to verify what goes on there.
home.netdoc.scope3: How to make sure you are on the real site? Check the URL in your browser's address bar. If it does not start with https://myktamap.fr or https://dev.myktamap.fr, nothing written on this page concerns you — it is a copy we have no control over.
home.netdoc.title: 📖 What does the app do on the network?
home.netdoc.verify1: Internal log: the « 📋 View the network log » button in the same section — logs in real time every request the app emits.
home.netdoc.verify2: Browser DevTools (F12): « Network » tab → you see every request, regardless of what the app claims. Filter by method to confirm there is no POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.
home.netdoc.verify3: Strict offline mode: tick the toggle in the same section. The browser will actively refuse any non-whitelisted request — the app stays 100% functional.
home.netdoc.verify4: Content Security Policy: F12 → Network → first request (HTML) → Headers tab → look for Content-Security-Policy. The Nginx server tells the browser to block any non-whitelisted connection (connect-src 'self' https://www.gstatic.com).

lost.tips.attendre.1: Settle in an identifiable spot (numbered shaft, named chamber, visible marking).
lost.tips.attendre.2: Stay where you are if nobody knows you're there — moving makes things worse.
lost.tips.attendre.3: Mark your location (paint, tape, a bright bag) so you can be found.
lost.tips.calme.1: Stop. Breathe in. Sit down for a few seconds.
lost.tips.calme.2: Panic makes you lose your bearings and wastes light + energy.
lost.tips.calme.3: Eat/drink a little if you have something. Catch your breath.
lost.tips.comm.1: If you get a signal (often near shafts / under certain manholes) → tell someone on the surface BEFORE your battery dies.
lost.tips.comm.2: The 📋 Copy report button below prepares a ready-made message with your last position + elapsed time.
lost.tips.lumiere.1: Switch your lamp to economy mode. Dead lamp = serious situation.
lost.tips.lumiere.2: Keep a backup lamp if you have one (headlamp + pen light is ideal).
lost.tips.lumiere.3: Hydrate a little but ration it — stress dehydrates you fast.
lost.tips.nepas.1: Don't follow the water — fissures often lead to dangerous narrow passages.
lost.tips.nepas.2: Don't attempt an unknown passage just because it seems to go up / head "toward the outside".
lost.tips.nepas.3: Don't trust the phone tracker — it drifts, especially under stress (erratic movements).
lost.tips.orient.1: Retrace your steps rather than trying to reach your destination — statistically more reliable.
lost.tips.orient.2: Look for the main axes (main galleries, straight galleries, railway tracks). They almost always lead to a known landmark.
lost.tips.orient.3: Use a physical compass — not the phone's, distorted by the ground and metal framework. Re-orient yourself at every junction.
lost.tips.orient.4: Listen to the sounds: traffic, subway, train, running water = useful directional clue.

oom.kill.howTitle: 💡 How to avoid it happening again
oom.kill.intro: Last time, the app shut down abruptly and couldn't save its session normally.
oom.kill.tip.closeApps: Close other background apps before using MyKTAMap. On iPhone: double-tap Home or swipe up + dismiss the cards. On Android: multitask button + swipe away.
oom.kill.tip.export: Export your session regularly (📤 Export) so you lose nothing in case of an abrupt shutdown.
oom.kill.tip.optimize: If the problem persists on a specific map, its main image may be too large — it then needs re-optimizing (PNG compression or smaller dimensions).
oom.kill.tip.perf: Lower the performance mode in the loader (🚀 icon or via ⚙️ Settings). "Performance" loads smaller tiles and uses less RAM than "Quality".
oom.kill.tip.tabs: Avoid opening multiple browser tabs at once if you use the app via Safari/Chrome — each tab also uses memory.
oom.kill.tip.update: Keep your smartphone up to date: iOS and Android regularly improve their memory management for PWAs.
oom.kill.whyBody: On smartphones (iOS and Android), the operating system silently kills tabs and installed apps that use too much RAM. That's very often what happened here, especially if you're using a high-resolution map or many other apps were running at the same time.
oom.v2.explain: It's very likely a browser memory overload — V2 conversion decodes the source image at full resolution then generates N tiles, which can exceed the memory cap of mobile browsers (~500 MB on iOS Safari, variable on Android).
oom.v2.intro: Last time, you were running the V2 conversion of map {nom} (image {taille}) and the app shut down abruptly before it finished.
oom.v2.sol.closeApps: Close other apps in the background to free up RAM before retrying.
oom.v2.sol.pc: Do the conversion on a PC (Windows / macOS / Linux). No memory cap in practice. Once the V2 ZIP is generated, import it on your phone — the import is lightweight (no full-resolution decoding).
oom.v2.sol.resize: Shrink the source image to 6000-8000 px max before retrying (GIMP / Photoshop / Squoosh).
